description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Method for defermination of  Customs value under the Schedule 'E' of the Customs (Amendment) Act No. 2 of 2003 for disposal of vehicles imported on 100% duty free basis
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a method for determining customs value under the Customs (Amendment) Act No. 2 of 2003, specifically for disposal of vehicles imported on a duty-free basis. It outlines regulatory procedures, depreciation schedules, and fiscal levy calculations, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Minister of Finance is incidental to the regulatory content and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a hybrid gazette.
